anyOf.description: The Installation selects no Credential Gateway, so credential sources cannot be registered.

OCC re-checks these grants against the initiator while the work runs.

cause.description: Why the startup model check failed, classified by the runtime.

detail.description: A fixed token for the kind, such as exit-1, signal-SIGKILL, error-ENOBUFS, format, rate_limit, billing, no_model, turn-failed, tool-event, no-reply, json or shape. Never native output.

kind.description: PROCESS_EXIT: the check process exited nonzero, was killed or could not run. PROBE_STATUS: the check ran and reported the model unusable. INVALID_OUTPUT: its output was not the expected JSON. WRAPPER_ERROR: the runtime wrapper could not prepare or read the check.

error.description: Null unless deployment failed. A failure contains code, a fixed safe message, and optional allowlisted data. CONVERGENCE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED may include data.timeoutMs and data.runtimeFailure with bounded startup-failure evidence. RUNTIME_MODEL_PROBE_FAILED may include data.runtimeFailure with the classified cause of the startup model check failure. Native error text is never returned.

lastAttempt.description: Latest reconciliation result bound to this exact deployment work item. Null means no bound result is available, not proof that work never ran. Codes and messages are allowlisted; provider text is not exposed.

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest time queued work is eligible to run, not a promised start time. Null while claimed.

progress.description: Pending deployment progress. Null for terminal outcomes. A last attempt describes a recorded result, not current runtime health.

warnings.description: Warnings recorded from this deployment startup. Plugin install and connector-auth warnings mean the deployment succeeded after the runtime disabled the affected admitted plugin for that startup.

pluginId.description: The admitted Agent plugin selection key.

503.description: Service Unavailable. Check `error.code`: `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` means workspace access is unavailable. `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` means OCC could not confirm the write or its audit record; the file may already contain the requested content. Read the same file with `GET` and compare its content before deciding whether to retry. If the content matches, do not retry. If you cannot read it, wait or ask someone with `read` permission on the Agent to check.
